title: Trader Diary: 79k BTC & My 5x Leverage Dreams
content:
📈 79,984 → I see green, I open 5x long.
💥 0.4% later: price dips 2% → my margin call pops like a confetti cannon.
🤦‍♂️ End result: coffee is cold, wallet is lighter.
lesson: Never risk more than you can afford to lose – especially on 5x.
question: Who else watched their 5x melt faster than ice cream in July? Drop your war stories 👇
